title.zh: 【日本大和证券将发行约 1.9 亿美元东京写字楼数字证券，面向个人投资者销售】
title.en: 【日本大和证券将发行约 1.9 亿美元东京写字楼数字证券，面向个人投资者销售】

current_state.zh: Daiwa Securities will issue about $190 million in digital securities backed by Tokyo office assets acquired from Blackstone and sell them to individual investors, the largest single real-estate digital security issuance to date.
current_state.en: Daiwa Securities will issue about $190 million in digital securities backed by Tokyo office assets acquired from Blackstone and sell them to individual investors, the largest single real-estate digital security issuance to date.
